data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis #4, IMPORTANT): dd-4 baseline semantics — detection (closed 7913) is ALREADY landed, so running detect.sh today against the fixture ALREADY emits a sweep marker; a 'no-marker baseline' is NOT producible by running current detect.sh. The test asserts a POSITIVE DIFFERENTIAL: the CURRENT migration-aware run HAS the marker+pair-contract-field while the committed baseline does NOT (proving the epic added them). dd-4's own AC already asserts the baseline file contains no marker/pair tokens; ADD that the test asserts the current run's output DIFFERS from (is a superset of) the baseline (marker present now, absent in baseline). Document the hand-authored baseline provenance + regeneration in the test header.
